verses.zh: 所罗门作以色列众人的王。
verses.en: King Solomon ruled over all Israel.

verses.zh: 他的臣子记在下面：撒督的儿子亚撒利雅作祭司，
verses.en: These were his officials:Azariah son of Zadok was the priest.

verses.zh: 示沙的两个儿子以利何烈、亚希亚作书记，亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官，
verses.en: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, wrote down what happened.[NOTE:1] Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was in charge of the records.
notes: Heb “were scribes”; NASB, NIV, NRSV “secretaries”; TEV, NLT “court secretaries.”

verses.zh: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅作元帅，撒督和亚比亚他作祭司长，
verses.en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was commander of[NOTE:1] the army.Zadok and Abiathar were priests.
notes: Heb “was over.”

verses.zh: 拿单的儿子亚撒利雅作众吏长，王的朋友拿单的儿子撒布得作领袖，
verses.en: Azariah son of Nathan was supervisor of[NOTE:1] the district governors.Zabud son of Nathan was a priest and adviser to[NOTE:2] the king.
notes: Heb “was over.”
Heb “close associate of”; KJV, ASV, NASB “the king’s friend” (a title for an adviser, not just an acquaintance).

verses.zh: 亚希煞作家宰，亚比大的儿子亚多尼兰掌管服苦的人。
verses.en: Ahishar was supervisor of the palace.[NOTE:1] Adoniram son of Abda was supervisor of[NOTE:2] the work crews.[NOTE:3]
notes: Heb “over the house.”
Heb “was over.”
The work crews. This Hebrew word (מַס, mas) refers to a group of laborers conscripted for royal or public service.

verses.zh: 所罗门在以色列全地立了十二个官吏，使他们供给王和王家的食物，每年各人供给一月。
verses.en: Solomon had 12 district governors appointed throughout Israel who acquired supplies for the king and his palace. Each was responsible for one month in the year.

verses.zh: 他们的名字记在下面：在以法莲山地有便・户珥；
verses.en: These were their names:Ben Hur was in charge of the hill country of Ephraim.

verses.zh: 在玛迦斯、沙宾、伯・示麦、以伦・伯・哈南有便・底甲；
verses.en: Ben Deker was in charge of Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh, and Elon Beth Hanan.

verses.zh: 在亚鲁泊有便・希悉，他管理梭哥和希弗全地；
verses.en: Ben Hesed was in charge of Arubboth; he controlled Socoh and all the territory of Hepher.

verses.zh: 在多珥山冈（或译：全境）有便・亚比拿达，他娶了所罗门的女儿她法为妻；
verses.en: Ben Abinadab was in charge of Naphath Dor. (He was married to Solomon’s daughter Taphath.)

verses.zh: 在他纳和米吉多，并靠近撒拉他拿、耶斯列下边的伯．善全地，从伯．善到亚伯．米何拉直到约念之外，有亚希律的儿子巴拿；
verses.en: Baana son of Ahilud was in charge of Taanach and Megiddo,[NOTE:1] as well as all of Beth Shean next to Zarethan below Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah and on past Jokmeam.
notes: For location see Map1-D4; Map2-C1; Map4-C2; Map5-F2; Map7-B1.

verses.zh: 在基列的拉末有便・基别，他管理在基列的玛拿西子孙睚珥的城邑，巴珊的亚珥歌伯地的大城六十座，都有城墙和铜闩；
verses.en: Ben Geber was in charge of Ramoth Gilead; he controlled the villages of Jair son of Manasseh in Gilead, as well as the region of Argob in Bashan, including 60 large walled cities with bronze bars locking their gates.

verses.zh: 在玛哈念有易多的儿子亚希拿达；
verses.en: Ahinadab son of Iddo was in charge of Mahanaim.

verses.zh: 在拿弗他利有亚希玛斯，他也娶了所罗门的一个女儿巴实抹为妻；
verses.en: Ahimaaz was in charge of Naphtali. (He married Solomon’s daughter Basemath.)

verses.zh: 在亚设和亚禄有户筛的儿子巴拿；
verses.en: Baana son of Hushai was in charge of Asher and Aloth.

verses.zh: 在以萨迦有帕路亚的儿子约沙法；
verses.en: Jehoshaphat son of Paruah was in charge of Issachar.

verses.zh: 在便雅悯有以拉的儿子示每；
verses.en: Shimei son of Ela was in charge of Benjamin.

verses.zh: 在基列地，就是从前属亚摩利王西宏和巴珊王噩之地，有乌利的儿子基别一人管理。
verses.en: Geber son of Uri was in charge of the land of Gilead (the territory which had once belonged to King Sihon of the Amorites and to King Og of Bashan). He was sole governor of the area.

verses.zh: 犹大人和以色列人如同海边的沙那样多，都吃喝快乐。
verses.en: The people of Judah and Israel were as innumerable as the sand on the seashore; they had plenty to eat and drink and were happy.

verses.zh: 所罗门统管诸国，从大河到非利士地，直到埃及的边界。所罗门在世的日子，这些国都进贡服事他。
verses.en: (5:1)[NOTE:1] Solomon ruled all the kingdoms from the Euphrates River[NOTE:2] to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt. These kingdoms paid tribute as Solomon’s subjects throughout his lifetime.[NOTE:3]
notes: Beginning with 4:21, the verse numbers through 5:18 in the English Bible differ from the verse numbers in the Hebrew text (BHS), with 4:21 ET = 5:1 HT, 4:22 ET = 5:2 HT, etc., through 5:18 ET = 5:32 HT. Beginning with 6:1 the numbering of verses in the English Bible and the Hebrew text is again the same.
Heb “the River” (also in v. 24). This is the standard designation for the Euphrates River in biblical Hebrew.
Heb “[They] were bringing tribute and were serving Solomon all the days of his life.”

verses.zh: 所罗门每日所用的食物：细面三十歌珥，粗面六十歌珥，
verses.en: Each day Solomon’s royal court consumed[NOTE:1] 30 cors[NOTE:2] of finely milled flour, 60 cors of cereal,
notes: Heb “the food of Solomon for each day was.”
As a unit of dry measure a cor was roughly equivalent to six bushels.

verses.zh: 肥牛十只，草场的牛二十只，羊一百只，还有鹿、羚羊、麃子，并肥禽。
verses.en: 10 calves fattened in the stall,[NOTE:1] 20 calves from the pasture, and 100 sheep, not to mention rams, gazelles, deer, and well-fed birds.
notes: The words “in the stall” are added for clarification; note the immediately following reference to cattle from the pasture.

verses.zh: 所罗门管理大河西边的诸王，以及从提弗萨直到迦萨的全地，四境尽都平安。
verses.en: His royal court was so large because[NOTE:1] he ruled over all the kingdoms west of the Euphrates River from Tiphsah[NOTE:2] to Gaza; he was at peace with all his neighbors.[NOTE:3]
notes: Heb “because.” The words “his royal court was so large” are added to facilitate the logical connection with the preceding verse.
Tiphsah. This was located on the Euphrates River.
Heb “for he was ruling over all [the region] beyond the River, from Tiphsah to Gaza, over all the kingdoms beyond the River, and he had peace on every side all around.”

verses.zh: 所罗门在世的日子，从但到别是巴的犹大人和以色列人都在自己的葡萄树下和无花果树下安然居住。
verses.en: All the people of Judah and Israel had security; everyone from Dan to Beer Sheba enjoyed the produce of their vines and fig trees throughout Solomon’s lifetime.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “Judah and Israel lived securely, each one under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan to Beer Sheba, all the days of Solomon.”

verses.zh: 所罗门有套车的马四万，还有马兵一万二千。
verses.en: Solomon had 4,000 stalls[NOTE:1] for his chariot horses and 12,000 horses.
notes: The Hebrew text has “40,000,” but this is probably an inflated number (nevertheless it is followed by KJV, ASV, NASB, NRSV, TEV, CEV). Some Greek mss of the OT and the parallel in 2 Chr 9:25 read “4,000” (cf. NAB, NIV, NCV, NLT).

verses.zh: 那十二个官吏各按各月供给所罗门王，并一切与他同席之人的食物，一无所缺。
verses.en: The district governors acquired supplies for King Solomon and all who ate in his royal palace.[NOTE:1] Each was responsible for one month in the year; they made sure nothing was lacking.
notes: Heb “everyone who drew near to the table of King Solomon.”

verses.zh: 众人各按各分，将养马与快马的大麦和干草送到官吏那里。
verses.en: Each one also brought to the assigned location his quota of barley and straw for the various horses.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “barley and straw for the horses and the steeds they brought to the place which was there, each according to his measure.”

verses.zh: 神赐给所罗门极大的智慧聪明和广大的心，如同海沙不可测量。
verses.en: God gave Solomon wisdom and very great discernment; the breadth of his understanding[NOTE:1] was as infinite as the sand on the seashore.
notes: Heb “heart,” i.e., mind. (The Hebrew term translated “heart” often refers to the mental faculties.)

verses.zh: 所罗门的智慧超过东方人和埃及人的一切智慧。
verses.en: Solomon was wiser than all the men of the east and all the sages of Egypt.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “the wisdom of Solomon was greater than the wisdom of all the sons of the east and all the wisdom of Egypt.”

verses.zh: 他的智慧胜过万人，胜过以斯拉人以探，并玛曷的儿子希幔、甲各、达大的智慧。他的名声传扬在四围的列国。
verses.en: He was wiser than any man, including Ethan the Ezrahite or Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol. He was famous in all the neighboring nations.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “his name was in all the surrounding nations.”

verses.zh: 他作箴言三千句，诗歌一千零五首。
verses.en: He composed[NOTE:1] 3,000 proverbs and 1,005 songs.
notes: Heb “spoke.”

verses.zh: 他讲论草木，自黎巴嫩的香柏树直到墙上长的牛膝草，又讲论飞禽走兽、昆虫水族。
verses.en: He produced manuals on botany, describing every kind of plant,[NOTE:1] from the cedars of Lebanon to the hyssop that grows on walls. He also produced manuals on biology, describing[NOTE:2] animals, birds, insects, and fish.
notes: Heb “he spoke about plants.”
Heb “he spoke about.”

verses.zh: 天下列王听见所罗门的智慧，就都差人来听他的智慧话。
verses.en: People from all nations came to hear Solomon’s display of wisdom;[NOTE:1] they came from all the kings of the earth who heard about his wisdom.
notes: Heb “the wisdom of Solomon.”
